name: @repo/animated-list
description: A list that animates additions, removals and reordering, with an optional auto-feed mode.

useCases: Live notification feed that reveals items one at a time
Activity log with additions, removals and reordering
Leaderboard-style list where older entries recede visually
compositionHints: Use with animated-avatar-group inside each list item
Pair with pinned-list when some entries need to stay on top
